cas.description: CAS Registry Number. Only a CAS-identified batch item can resolve experimental results; CAS takes precedence when SMILES is also supplied.

modules.description: Selected calculations. Items run in canonical dependency order rather than submitted array order; use waterSolubilityProvider for the shared water-solubility choice.

molecularWeight.description: Optional resolved molecular weight. Part of the complete positive VP/WSOL/MW triplet that enables the HENRYWIN VP/WSOL candidate.

smiles.description: Raw structure input. A SMILES-only batch item is estimated without experimental results.

vaporPressureMmHg.description: Optional resolved vapor pressure in mmHg. Its omission leaves structural HENRYWIN candidates available.

vaporPressureTemperatureC.description: Fixed MPBPVP calculation temperature in °C; values other than 25 are rejected.

waterSolubilityMgPerL.description: Optional resolved water solubility in mg/L. Its omission leaves structural HENRYWIN candidates available.

experimentalBioconcentrationFactor.description: Packaged CAS-backed experimental BCF in L/kg wet-wt, derived as 10^experimentalLogBioconcentrationFactor. This comparison value does not replace the calculated BCF.

experimentalBiotransformationHalfLife.description: Packaged experimental biotransformation half-life in days, derived as 10^experimentalLogBiotransformationHalfLife.

experimentalBioTransformationRate.description: Compatibility projection in day^-1, derived as ln(2) divided by the packaged experimental half-life. It is not an estimator input or selected calculated rate.

experimentalEvidence.description: Source and value-type metadata for the raw packaged log values. Keys are present only for available evidence.

experimentalLogBioconcentrationFactor.description: Curated dimensionless log10 BCF evidence, when available for the CAS-backed structure.

experimentalLogBiotransformationHalfLife.description: Curated log10 biotransformation half-life in days, when available for the CAS-backed structure.

originalEqcKocComparison.description: The historical original-EQC Koc comparison (0.41 × 10^logKow), in L/kg. It is reported for context and is not substituted into the Level III calculation.

selectedKoc.description: The resolved soil Koc used by the Level III calculation, in L/kg.

coefficient.description: Per-fragment coefficient. Null for nonlinear correction formulas and rows without a scientific contribution.

maxFragmentCount.description: Bond maximum training-set fragment count. Null for Group rows, whose source supplies no maximum-count metadata.

totalCoefficient.description: Total row contribution. Null for missing-fragment and note-only rows; explicit correction totals remain authoritative even when coefficient is null.

trainingCount.description: Bond training-set occurrence count. Null for Group rows, whose source supplies no training-count metadata.

nativeValue.description: Method-native result: LWAPC/log-gamma for Bond or Group and atm-m3/mol for VP/WSOL.

value.description: Compatibility alias for the method-native result. Prefer nativeValue with nativeUnits or the explicit HLC projections.

selectedMethod.description: Preferred calculated candidate. This can differ from the provenance of selectedValue when a user-provided or packaged-evidence value is selected.

HydrolysisHalfLife.description: Flat compatibility half-life projection normalized to days. Pathway-scoped half-lives retain their original context in pathways.

mechanism.description: Combined denotes a native summary that cannot be assigned to one catalytic mechanism.

originalValue.description: Unnormalized native half-life value, retained with originalUnit.

pH.description: pH associated with the native summary, or null when no single pH applies.

HydrolysisMessage.description: A message scoped by its containing response, pathway, or site.

HydrolysisPathway.description: One independently classified hydrolysis pathway. Nested sites, rates, half-lives, evidence, and messages retain their scope.

evidenceText.description: Native evidence text scoped to this pathway, or null when the report provides none.

HydrolysisPathwayHalfLife.description: Half-life scoped to one pathway and preserved in its native unit.

mechanism.description: Null means the report did not assign a base-, acid-, or neutral-catalyzed mechanism.

HydrolysisRate.description: Rate estimate scoped by its containing pathway or site. It is not a flat response-wide compatibility projection.

logUnit.description: Unit or label associated with logValue.

value.description: Reported rate value, or null when unavailable.

HydrolysisRateEstimate.description: Flat compatibility rate projection. For site- and pathway-scoped estimates, use pathways.

unit.description: Canonical unit for this flat compatibility projection.

value.description: Estimated native rate constant, or null when the status is not-estimated.

HydrolysisReportParts.description: Preserved native report sections. These strings are available only in full responses.

details.description: Native detailed functional-group and calculation section.

HydrolysisSite.description: A reactive site within its containing pathway. Native functional-group text can contain line breaks.

functionalGroup.description: Native functional-group representation for this site.

HydrolysisSubstituent.description: Native substituent text associated with one reactive site.

HydrolysisSuccess.description: Full HYDROWIN response. pathways is the primary structured result; the top-level rates, halfLives, fragments, notes, and alerts are flat compatibility projections and can lose pathway or site scope.

alerts.description: Legacy flat report alerts retained for compatibility.

disposition.description: Overall outcome after all HYDROWIN pathways are considered.

fragments.description: Legacy flat functional-group projection. It does not replace pathway site records.

halfLives.description: Lossy flat compatibility projection normalized to days. Use pathways for scoped native half-lives.

messages.description: Response-scoped messages. Pathway- and site-scoped messages remain nested in pathways.

notes.description: Legacy flat report notes retained for compatibility.

output.description: Preserved native primary output. Omitted by compact responses; reportParts.summary remains separately available in full responses.

pathways.description: Ordered authoritative pathways. The Malathion example is representative and abbreviated; actual site, message, evidence, rate, and half-life rows vary by chemical.

rates.description: Lossy flat compatibility projection of selected rates. Use pathways for scoped rates.

method.description: Packaged evidence method code when this value was selected from attached evidence.

info.description: HTTP API for chemical search, EPI Suite estimation, typed ECOSAR calculations, and synchronous batch estimation. The built-in server has no authentication. Query names and response paths are canonical; legacy client aliases are not accepted. Single-submit values are carried in URLs and batch values in JSON request bodies, so deployments must keep request logs private and users must not submit confidential business information.
